summary_en: 30,000 shares (2.14% of S/O ex-treasury), ¥90.0M upper limit, open-market acquisition, Aug 3–Dec 30, 2026. Purpose: stock option exercises and restricted-stock awards; future capital policy flexibility.
title_en: Notification of Resolution on Matters Concerning Acquisition of Treasury Shares
translation_en_brief: NOVA SYSTEM announced on 31 July 2026 that its board has resolved to acquire up to 30,000 shares of its own common stock, representing 2.14% of outstanding shares (excluding treasury), for a maximum aggregate consideration of ¥90.0 million. The shares will be acquired via open-market purchases on the Tokyo Stock Exchange between 3 August and 30 December 2026. The company states the purpose is to secure shares for future stock option exercises and awards under a restricted-stock compensation plan, while also enabling more flexible capital allocation strategy going forward. As of 31 July 2026, the company held 12,711 treasury shares against a total of 1,389,789 shares outstanding (excluding treasury).
